property_summary: After getFirstWithdrawalBonus(recipient) completes without revert, a subsequent identical call must revert because claimedBonus became true; the bug leaves it false, so the second call also succeeds.
change_summary: Replace claimedBonus[recipient] = true; with claimedBonus[recipient] = false; so the bonus can be claimed repeatedly, changing rewardsForA and thus getFirstWithdrawalBonus.
